Before you start, please review the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

How do I reply quickly without opening the editor?

In a conversation, the round button on the right sends (with an empty field it opens the full editor). You can turn the field off in Settings → Mail → Quick reply in messages and conversations.
How do I change the order of the buttons below a message?

Settings → Mail → Buttons below a message. By default they suit the right hand: Reply on the right, Delete away from the system Back button. You can choose For the left hand or arrange the buttons by dragging. The same place has Ask before deleting (on by default).
How do I get a deleted message back?

Right after deleting, an “Email Deleted · Undo” bar with a 7-second countdown appears at the bottom of the list, above the bottom panel — tap Undo. Archive and Move to Junk can be undone the same way. Later you can find the message in Deleted Items and move it back; for Exchange mailboxes there is also Recover deleted items in Settings.
Where do Archive and Move to Junk put a message?

Archive moves the message out of the Inbox into the archive folder without deleting anything, like the Archive button in Outlook. Move to Junk puts it into the junk folder: its messages are not shown in All Mail and do not notify you, and Not spam brings a message back to the Inbox. Exchange does not mark these folders specially, so the app recognizes them by name in many languages (Archive, Архив, Junk Email, Нежелательная почта…). If it picked the wrong folder or none, choose one yourself: Settings → Accounts → mailbox → Advanced settings → Archive folder and Junk folder.
What does a long press on a message do?

It opens the message card with buttons: reply, forward, read, follow up. More shows all actions in groups. You can keep your finger down, slide it onto a button and release. A long press on the sender picture selects several messages.
How do I pin a message to the top?
Long-press the message → More → Pin to top. Pinned messages appear above the list of their folder (up to 10). Use the same item to unpin.
How do I swipe between messages?
Open a message from the list and swipe left or right to open the neighbouring message. Turn it off in Settings → Mail → Swipe between emails.

How do I save a draft?

When you close an unfinished message, the app asks: Save draft, Discard or Keep writing. The disk icon at the top saves right away. The draft goes to the Drafts folder and is visible in Outlook or webmail too.
What does “Draft:” in a message row mean?
You started a reply to this message but did not send it. Tap Reply again — the same draft opens instead of a new one.
Are attachments kept in a draft?

Yes. Files you attach are kept with the draft text: on this device and in the Drafts folder on the server, so you also see them in Outlook and webmail. If the files exceed the mailbox limit, the draft stays on this device only. Files of a forwarded message that were not downloaded yet are fetched when you open the draft again.

Why do notifications arrive late on iPhone?

While the app is open, mail arrives immediately. When it is in the background, iOS decides on its own when to wake it: more often if you use the app every day, less often in Low Power Mode or when the battery is low. To make it wake up more often, keep Server signals (iPhone) on in Settings → Notifications: the developer’s server sends an empty “check your mail” signal through Apple at the interval you choose, and the app checks your mailboxes itself, from this device; only the notification token is sent to the server. Don’t close the app by swiping it away in the app switcher: after that iOS wakes it neither on its own nor by a signal until you open the app again. How is the Ogneliss archive different from the Archive button?

Archive moves a message into the archive folder on the server: it stays in the mailbox and takes space. The Ogneliss archive works like Outlook AutoArchive: whole messages with attachments and folders go into an encrypted file on the device, and on the server they go to Deleted Items. The archive shows in the menu as the Ogneliss archive section, is searched together with your mail and opens offline. Turn it on in Settings → Ogneliss archive.
How do I move the archive to another device or a cloud?

Settings → Ogneliss archive → Save an archive copy: put the .ogna file on Google Drive, Files with iCloud Drive, Yandex Disk, a USB drive or a computer. On the other device: Connect an archive copy → choose the file → archive password or recovery code. The copy is encrypted and cannot be opened without the password or the code. The app settings travel with the archive, and you can restore them on the same screen.
What if I forget the archive password?

Enter the recovery code shown when the archive was created instead of the password, then set a new password. Lost the code while the archive is open? Settings → Ogneliss archive → New recovery code. Without the password and the code nobody can open the archive: the key is not on our servers.
Why did some messages not go to the archive?

The archive takes messages that are on this device, within the mailbox sync period: to include older ones, choose Period → All mail in the mailbox settings. Flagged and tracked messages are not archived by default (there is a switch in the archive settings), nor are drafts, Trash and Junk. If a text or an attachment did not download, the message stays in the mailbox and goes with the next archiving run.
How do I bring back mailboxes and settings from the archive on a new device?

On the sign-in screen tap Connect an Ogneliss archive (or Settings → Ogneliss archive), connect the archive copy and, under App settings in the archive, tap Restore on this device. Mailboxes, signatures, notes and settings are added; if the archive kept mailbox passwords, you do not need to sign in again.
How do I change the greeting and signature in a message?

The app starts a message with a greeting: “Hello Name,”, or “Hello all,” for several recipients. If you have already written in this conversation, the reply gets a short form: “Name,” or “All,”. “Hello all,” is used only when every recipient is in your organisation; if some addresses belong to other organisations or public mail services (Gmail, Yahoo…), it is just “Hello,”. Above the message text there is a Greeting button with all variants: full, short, without a name and no greeting. The greeting is written in the app language, or in Russian if the recipient’s name is in Cyrillic. For each mailbox you can turn the greeting off or leave it without a name: Settings → Accounts → mailbox → Signatures → Greeting in messages. The signature is inserted automatically; pick another one with the pen button at the bottom of the message, and manage signatures in Signatures.
